'''Kor Qunaalac''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Qunaalac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].

==Description==
Kor Qunaalac was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Qunaalac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. This [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan controlled around one-third of the Hutt [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that defended the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]''. As a result, Kor Qunaalac was one of the most heavily defended throneworlds in the ''Bootana Hutta''.<ref name="LoNH" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had several large landmasses that were largely hilly and wet around their coastal regions, but dry inland with few natural [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] that were the favored habitats of the Hutts. To counter this perceived deficiency, the Qunaalac built many [[Dam/Legends|dams]] across the world to create large lakes and artificial swamps. One of the most well known Qunaalac estates on the world was [[Fort Dandunc]], which housed Qunaalac treasure vaults and war trophies.<ref name="LoNH" />
